clips.title: The story
paras: Following earlier inconclusive tests on surface troggs, Ozzie Togglevolt tasks adventurers with retrieving pure, high-potency radioactive fallout directly from inside Gnomeregan. His ultimate goal is to understand the toxic radiation that devastated his people and concoct a cure for the afflicted leper gnomes.

Ozzie Togglevolt's preliminary trials outside the city were a failure. The irradiated troggs roaming Dun Morogh carried insufficient and impure residue, leaving his lab in Kharanos with more questions than answers. To engineer a true remedy for leper gnomes, Togglevolt concludes that scientific integrity demands a fresh, concentrated sample directly from deep within the city's toxic belly.

Obtaining fallout of sufficient potency means braving Gnomeregan itself. The lower depths around the Hall of Gears and Clean Zone teem with irradiated horrors, lurkers, and slimes spawned by the disastrous venting of radioactive waste. Extracting this unstable ooze into a heavy leaden phial is hazardous work: the fallout rapidly degrades, making containment extremely volatile and time-sensitive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not only was your sample insufficient in quantity, it was also impure.

What we require is more green glow. The troggs are obviously not irradiated sufficiently to fulfill our needs. You will have to go into Gnomeregan and bring back some radioactive fallout, straight from the tap. I am speaking of the irradiated slimes, lurkers and horrors. Be warned, the containment of this type of fallout is difficult. You may need to make several attempts with the phial until a suitable sampling is recovered.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hrm, you're not glowing. That's a good sign.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive, you still have all of your limbs. Now it's time to see what this stuff can do!
